BERT4Rec reconstructs hidden items with bidirectional context; inference appends a mask and scores its representation. Sampling a training-prefix endpoint changes which interaction becomes the terminal target and how much preceding context remains. Favoring recent endpoints therefore changes target recency and context length alongside terminal supervision. Allowing endpoints among random reconstruction targets adds terminal loss; however, simultaneous interior masks leave corrupted history, unlike clean-history appended-mask inference. The original implementation combines random reconstruction examples with last-item-only examples. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/html/1904.06690v2), [original implementation](https://github.com/FeiSun/BERT4Rec/blob/master/gen_data_fin.py).

Mask probability controls supervision density and context corruption. Distinguish Bernoulli selection from fixed-count masking: original code selects min(cap, max(1, round(length × masked_lm_prob))) targets; its separate mask_prob controls replacement with the mask token. For independent Bernoulli masking over n eligible positions, zero-target probability is (1−p)^n. Skipping empty examples, resampling until nonempty, forcing a uniform target, or forcing the endpoint induce different training distributions; endpoint fallback particularly increases terminal supervision for short sequences. Also specify per-target versus per-sequence loss normalization, which changes sequence weighting. [Original masking code](https://github.com/FeiSun/BERT4Rec/blob/master/gen_data_fin.py).

Controlled ablations, inferred from these mechanics: freeze user/prefix draws, truncation, corruption masks, updates and loss normalization; vary only endpoint-loss weight. Separately compare endpoint eligibility while preserving interior masks, and compare endpoint-only supervision with clean versus corrupted history. Then vary prefix sampling with endpoint weight fixed, matching target-age and retained-context-length distributions in separate controls. Compare mask rates and zero-mask policies independently; record realized terminal-target frequency, masks/example and context length. Hold seeds, splits, architecture and validation candidates fixed; select by four-category macro validation HR@10.
